name: human-ai-orientation
description: A short, self-guided course helping people who are not AI specialists build useful working relationships with AI. Learners bring their own AI tool, discover capabilities through personally relevant tasks, and develop a reusable context kit.

scripts.stop: systemctl --user stop orientation-cron.timer orientation-web.service orientation-php.service orientation-db.service
scripts.status: systemctl --user is-active orientation-db.service orientation-php.service orientation-web.service orientation-cron.timer
